field_status_definitions.insufficient_complete_samples: 当前分组或配对的完整执行样本不足，均值、区间或总量保持缺测；样本和计划分母见相同分组。
field_status_definitions.no_complete_snapshot_in_bounded_log_tail: 容器日志尾部缺少完整快照分量集合，逻辑字节区间无完整样本。
field_status_definitions.not_executed_after_cleanup_failure: trial_execution_status=BLOCKED_CLEANUP；前序清理失败使该计划 trial 保留在分母，执行观测为空。
field_status_definitions.uncollected_complete_trial_quota: 现有逻辑配额观测来自有界诊断历史；完整 trial 的累计 acting Token 释放量未采集。
field_status_definitions.uncollected_in_ci_runner: uncollected_in_ci_runner (see 128MiB boundary report): 未采集完整 trial 的块设备物理写入、压缩对象占用或连续磁盘余量；参考 docs/STORAGE_COSTS.md 与 docs/evidence/boundary-confirm-storage-a7e324a.json。

units.snapshot_write_bytes: measured physical bytes written during one trial
units.snapshot_logical_upload_bytes_observed: logical pre-compression bytes from bounded upload log tail

conclusion: 现有证据支持逐策略快照创建次数核算；物理快照写入量、压缩占用峰值及 I/O 风暴抑制尚缺实测。
